name: Capital-State Research Contract
inherits_frozen_boundary: T8 FINAL FROZEN 97879ca; T3-T8 stay FROZEN as Portfolio/Execution Layer
layer_identity: Capital-State Research = Market Understanding Layer; first round produces NO trading rules

causal_direction.rule: FORBIDDEN: inferring 'main-force accumulation/distribution' directly from a K-line or price-volume pattern

latent_state_principle.rule: Dominant capital / accumulation / locking / distribution are LATENT states. Without direct evidence, may only be stated as 'evidence consistent with hypothesis Hxx', never as actor fact.

levels.A: Direct Capital Evidence: holdings, subscriptions/redemptions, seats, insider/holder changes
levels.B: Chip / Ownership Evidence: concentration, cost migration, holding structure, turnover structure
levels.C: Price-Volume Proxy: price, volume, turnover, efficiency, momentum, MFE/DD end-stage proxies

evidence_levels.hard_constraint: Level C alone can NEVER establish a Level-A capital-actor state.

mechanism_first.rule: Every formal variable must be writable as: Capital Actor -> Behavior Mechanism -> Expected Observable -> Variable. FORBIDDEN: scanning many features first, then writing a capital story post hoc on significance.

policy_firewall.rule: Capital-State discovery stage FORBIDS selecting state definitions by return/Sharpe/backtest; FORBIDS modifying any T3-T8 frozen rule.

questions: which capital behavior does this variable correspond to?
why should that behavior theoretically produce this observation?
which OTHER mechanisms can produce the same number?
what independent evidence can distinguish these explanations?
anti_numeric_maze_gate.rule: any variable failing a complete answer goes to exploratory appendix, never into a Capital State Engine

hypothesis_gates.G-H-1: mechanism: explicit capital mechanism chain exists
hypothesis_gates.G-H-2: evidence independence: >=2 different sources/layers, not correlated technical indicators
hypothesis_gates.G-H-5: PIT: all real-time interpretive data satisfy point-in-time

stop_rule: after CSR-0..CSR-4 commits: STOP and await audit; no data ingestion before CSR-5/CSR-6 audit passes
north_star: who is the capital currently setting price; what chips do they hold and at what cost; are they adding/maintaining/transferring/exiting risk; and is the market/sector capital environment helping or fighting them
